reviews.name: Kelly Brammer
reviews.text: Wow what a transformation this restaurant has gone through! Beautiful interior. Very comfortable seating. Extremely efficient and friendly service. We had the #2 family dinner. What a great value. The sweet and sour chicken was just the right crispness. Not too greasy or spongy. The noodles tasted like they had Chinese 5-spice blend, very good. Mongolian beef, chicken teriyaki, stir fried rice, dumplings and egg rolls were all just perfect. Definitely will recommend to all my friends!

reviews.name: Jennifer Williams
reviews.text:
It was nice being able to use the self service to order food and take our time to look at things.
Very fast service.

reviews.name: Jennie May Weickum
reviews.text: WOW  NEVER EVER HAVE I BEEN TREATED WITH SUCH DISRESPECT!!! Completely ruthless ladies working the counter here!!! Also just wanted my order separate so after finding that out they took my order and mixed it anyway then tied my bag double so I couldn't easily open to comment a google review 🙃 WOW RUDE 👌 Better fix the prices along with attitude ladies 😒 😑  very disappointed in the environment here in person! Horrible way to be on church day for real!! Hope the best to the restaurant because I love the food usually 😋

reviews.name: janiev1000
reviews.text: The place is remodeled and now looks like very attractive Chinese restaurant.  Great ambiance, huge portions, extensive menu!

reviews.name: Zach Pearce
reviews.text: Food was amazing, it was hot and fresh and the wait to get our food wasn't long at all. Going during the week at lunch time probably helped! But my coke was cold and fresh, along with the seaweed salad, which was delicious. I also got the Rock N Roll sushi roll and it was also amazing! I also had the Broccoli and Beef and it too was delicious and amazing. Highly recommend!! We were also impressed with the Lego sets they had on display, I only took one picture which is the one I posted.

reviews.name: Kat
reviews.text: Atmosphere is beautiful, i just love all the decor, it makes it come together so well. I love the servers energy, its obvious they love their job! Im super excited to try the food!

reviews.name: jacob smith
reviews.text: Some of the best teriyaki I have ever had in my life! First time coming here and I'm sitting in the parking lot writing this review and thinking about what I'm gonna order next time.    I got the chicken teriyaki and Katsu which came with rice and a salad..... everything on my plate was delicious! Salad dressing is on point, rice is great, chicken teriyaki is cooked to perfection and the Katsu has such an amazing crunch on it.  Portions are huge as well for such a great price.  Service is wonderful.  What I'm trying to say is try this place

reviews.name: Richard Bryant
reviews.text: I did a rating on my first experience a week earlier, which was based on Teriyaki. This review is based on the Sush. We de idea to get the special $80 sushi combo. It was fantastic. Exceeded our expectations. Every course was a good amount. …

reviews.name: Lucy Ray
reviews.text: I love this place. I've been coming here since we moved to Sumner. It's my favorite restaurant on this side of town. I love them so much. I even came here when I was pregnant. Sadly, I couldn't have any sushi, but I'm up for it now. I love, salmon rolls, and the bento box with the chicken teriyaki. The service is always great. Very friendly staff, very professional and very quick to bring out the food.

reviews.name: Mauricio Landin
reviews.text: I had an absolutely phenomenal experience at Teriyaki Wok & Sushi. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming, clean, and comfortable. It’s the kind of place where you can tell the staff genuinely care about the food they …

reviews.name: Kevin Martin
reviews.text: Great food today. We had Orange chicken, s-9 teriyaki chicken with breaded almond chicken and teriyaki chicken with vegetable chow mein. Waiter was really nice and quick. We also had the miso soup. It was also awesome. We will eat here again.

reviews.name: Michelle Richardson
reviews.text: They have great food, but.... When I order fried rice I didn't want to see that they put no ever into it! I literally keep getting white rice with maybe 3 carrots and 4 peas, with a little bit of color to make it look like fried rice! Now …

reviews.name: Kevin Combs
reviews.text: We've ordered takeout from here more than a few times.  This was the first time we dined in.  Somehow, the food was even better.  The staff here is ridiculously friendly! They always greet you with a smile and seem genuine happy to see their customers.  The sushi is amazing!... but so is all their food!  It's a shame I can only give 5 stars!  100% will be back.

reviews.name: Seonyoung Ahn
reviews.text: The menu here is large and varied! So many options.  We tried a couple rolls and sashimi. Everything was flavorful, fresh, and delicious. Beautiful presentation. The restaurant itself is very clean and the atmosphere is very nice and pleasing. We’ll definitely be back. everything has been 5 stars. Love this place!

reviews.name: Zoey Gibson
reviews.text:
Wonderful people and wonderful service. Very kind and friendly and smile a lot! Would reccomend.

They've done a lot with the place, making it very vibrant and unique compared to other dining areas. Always improving in the decor.

reviews.name: marseclipse -
reviews.text: We’ve been going here for years, and without fail, the food and service is 10/10. It’s always consistent, and we’ve never had a bad meal here. Definitely the best teriyaki place in Bonney Lake and I cannot recommend it enough.

reviews.name: Colby Foster
reviews.text: Amazing food! My fiancé got the chicken fried rice and I got the combination fried rice. We also got the egg rolls and house salad, we have been coming here for years! Great quality and phenomenal service!

reviews.name: Heidi Grande
reviews.text: Absolutely phenomenal. Great food, amazing prices (we love the $50 family meal), and the sweetest employees! Whether it's take out or in-restaurant, it's the best!

reviews.name: Kelly Brammer
reviews.text: The staff was super friendly and very accommodating. The food was prepared correctly and came in a timely manner. Excellent serving size and it was very tasty. I think the only downside was when I went to the bathroom I walked across the hard floor and it was sticky.

reviews.name: Adara Lombardi
reviews.text: This place has been a go to for me and my boyfriend for a few years now. They are always very fast with getting our orders out and the service is friendly and inviting. Chicken teriyaki and gyoza combo is our favorites. Portion sizes are amazing as well!

reviews.name: Andrew Gaddy
reviews.text: If you have not been yet, it's time to start. Long time customer. Always has friendly sociable employees.. but, you can't beat the quality plus price. Best of both in the area and teriyaki wok deserves to thrive!

reviews.name: That Guy
reviews.text: Always a favorite of my families. Staff is friendly, the options are what you normally would expect with the addition of sushi. Bonus, they are open on Sundays, but closed on mondays.

reviews.name: eddiesut13
reviews.text:
Update 2/1/2024:
New owners. Now includes a sushi bar.  Food was great and the staff was friendly. Very busy with a lot of to go orders.  Family Dinner #1 was so much food. Lots of leftovers. Recommended

Update 6/12/2022:
Family style dinners are a lot of food!  Very good tonight.  Staff is always great.  Katsu chicken is very good. This place has really been consistent over the last two years.  Recommended

Old review:
Staff was friendly and very good. Environment seemed pretty clean to me.  Spacious with multiple tables. Ordered the teriyaki chicken and Beijing beef and received egg flower soup before the main dish arrived. The soup, chicken, and beef were all of decent quality and flavor but nothing really stood out. A nice average teriyaki shop close to home.  Wouldn't rule out going again but it isn't on my must have list.

reviews.name: Benjamin Gilbert
reviews.text: I got the Bulgogi, and it was just basic stir fry with vegetables. Not Bulgogi as I've ever had it. No spice, very little flavor, just cooked meat and veggies. It wasn't unpleasant, just joyless and unflavored. Maybe they mixed up my order …

reviews.name: Jay Freeman
reviews.text:
I asked My Buddies- Why didn’t you tell me about the one teriyaki joint by Les Schwab in BL?
C’mon now? Teriyaki Wok is so delicious!
If you’re getting a tire patched at Les Schwab walk next door - so good!

My buddy said that the Deep fried Amond chicken with gravy and fried rice is really good too.

I got a bowl of spicy chicken and added extra spicy sauce.

I got a bowl of miso soup, some pot stickers,
scallop and eel sashimi,
a Double Double sushi Roll with two kinds of tuna and a Rainbow Roll.

The fish was fresh and had the thicker cut that I enjoy.

The hot tea was refilled regularly and the service from “Phoebe” was truly excellent.

I will definitely be back soon.

reviews.name: A Google User
reviews.text: We eat here and bring our family all the time! Really fast cooking times and friendly service. Wonderful portions and always great food.

reviews.name: Teresa Simmons
reviews.text: Not only super yummy food, and enormous portions, the staff goes above and beyond! I ordered from Ohio for my sister who was fresh out of the hospital. I called to make sure she got her 2 Teriyaki sauces. SHE GOT 4! LITTLE KINDNESSES KEEP US GOING IN THIS CURRENT CRAZY WORLD🙏

reviews.name: Nick Wilson
reviews.text: The new owners are knocking it out of the park here. The food is great, the service is awesome, and the atmosphere is very welcoming. Out of the five or six Teriyaki places in Bonney Lake, this one has risen far above the rest.

reviews.name: Jamesktlee
reviews.text: This place teriyaki and other are so good.  Today they just opened for sushi.  Omg these sushi are same one that I had one in Osaka Japan.  Super thick cut and so fresh!  Chef is very experienced and really good. Will come back again!!! Love it so much Sushi and sashimi!!!!

reviews.name: marisa mom
reviews.text: The woman who served us was friendly and provided lots of teriyaki. The music and food were good. We got the family meal which was a great deal that came with a lot of food.

reviews.name: Marina Ribeiro
reviews.text: I wish i could give 1000 stars, we came here for a birthday lunch, the staff was amazing, the food was SO good… the whole experience was perfect, thank you guys!!

reviews.name: Chris Titus
reviews.text: We just had an amazing sushi dinner at teriyaki wok. They just added sushi to the menu a couple of days ago. All we could say was WOW!! There are several new sushi spots on the hill and we have tried almost all of them except one I believe. …

reviews.name: Jason Bailey
reviews.text:
Excellent Food, Excellent Service!!! Friendly!!
Thank you Lucas

reviews.name: Doug Graff
reviews.text: This is our family’s favorite place we drive from puyallup to come here. The price is affordable and the food is great

reviews.name: Kuffs 9855
reviews.text: Had never tried this restaurant before decided to stop in today. In talking with the gentleman behind the counter they are the new owners. I had the sweet and sour chicken and tried the miso soup, my husband had the chicken and beef combo. It was all fantastic the sweet and sour chicken was crispy and fresh and so good. I highly recommend checking it out!

reviews.name: Catherine Faux
reviews.text: My husband and I come here all the time! The food is amazing! Especially the teriyaki chicken! The ambience is also really nice.

reviews.name: John L
reviews.text:
Spotted in the wild: Captain Jonathan Hillstrand of the Time Bandit from Deadliest Catch!
If this seasoned fisherman chooses Teriyaki Wok and Sushi, you know it’s the real deal. This hidden gem is clearly no secret to those who know their seafood—and I’m right there with him.

The sushi? Fresh, flavorful, and generously portioned. Their sashimi selection is top-notch, and the teriyaki and wok dishes are just as impressive—savory, satisfying, and perfectly cooked.

Service is fast, friendly, and attentive. You feel welcomed the moment you walk in, and the quality never misses.

I heard Captain Hillstrand’s a regular here, and after my visit, I totally get it.
I’ll be back soon—and often. Great food, great service, and a surprise celebrity sighting? What more could you ask for.

reviews.name: Zyfon E
reviews.text: Great service, really good food, nice people

reviews.name: Colton E
reviews.text: I wish I could give a better rating. The inside of the restaurant is nice and the customer service was fast and friendly. However the food was completely bland and tasteless. We got Mongolian beef with chow mein, and broccoli beef with chow mein and both tasted like they were steamed with no seasoning or flavor whatsoever. Pretty disappointing considering I paid 60 dollars for the food and had to try and flavor it myself at home. The egg rolls were pretty good but that isn’t enough to bring me back in the future.

reviews.name: Brett Roper
reviews.text: Got a salmon, yellowtail, and California roll. The salmon roll was delicious and fresh, the green onions in the yellowtail were tasty, and that was hands down the best California roll I've ever had in my life. Will definitely be coming here again.

reviews.name: Nicole Fifield
reviews.text: Delicious teriyaki! Plus I get to order yummy sushi! Definitely a must try. Clean inside and the staff is very kind

reviews.name: Arymari3
reviews.text: great food and customer service. and nice atmosphere, would definitely recommend!

reviews.name: Heather Beekley
reviews.text: The best place to eat and the staff were so sweet and amazing. Great food, wonderful atmosphere and we will for sure be back!

reviews.name: Zia
reviews.text: Great atmosphere and service! Food was on point and music as well! Totally recommend especially the lunch combo #1!

reviews.name: Sheri Beutler
reviews.text: My favorite teriyaki place in town! Always so fresh and great service too! My entire family loves to come here!

reviews.name: Edward Bolster
reviews.text: Best sushi. Coming from Hawaii this is the best place away from home. Especially the food. Great portions and a tone of flavor

reviews.name: Mariana Marsalisi
reviews.text: My family and I always come here and love it! The food is delicious, the people are so kind and welcoming! Love love love!

reviews.name: Payton Wood
reviews.text: staff is very friendly and the food is always very good and comes out quickly!!

reviews.name: Justin Ennis
reviews.text: Staff was so friendly, we even had success sitting through a meal with our toddler. Fantastic!!

reviews.name: Brent Wanamaker
reviews.text: Wonderful service! Food came quickly and was very delicious! Great place!

reviews.name: Laura Thompson
reviews.text: Food was great. Big portions! Delicious. Friendly st as of and clean.

reviews.name: Ravid
reviews.text: Amazing dishes, really enjoyed the meal and overall service

reviews.name: Cassidy Jones
reviews.text: Everytime our family comes the food is delicious no matter what we order!!

reviews.name: Alicia Lavin
reviews.text: Have enjoyed going here for many years. Great, friendly service and consistently yummy food. No problem recommending it to others!

reviews.name: DeAysia Harris
reviews.text: For this place to have 4.3 stars I was completely shocked by the food. My bf and I got two separate dishes (Mongolian beef/w chow mein & beef and broccoli w/chow mein) both completely lacking any flavor at all. The food was hot but that is about all it had to offer. Zero flavor would not recommend. Very disappointing.

reviews.name: Billy Eakins
reviews.text: Great atmosphere, great food. Sat me right away and were friendly. I will be back

reviews.name: Soyeun Park (Sienna)
reviews.text: This restaurant's owner James’s sashimi is the best I've eaten in nearby areas, including Tacoma, Federal Way.

reviews.name: tyler vallala
reviews.text: Best sweet and sour chicken in town. Service is great very friendly.

reviews.name: Heidi
reviews.text: Amazing beef short ribs! Service is great & environment is friendly! Love coming here with my family, this place never disappoints! 10/10

reviews.name: angela tapia
reviews.text: Love this place, the food is great and the service is even better. They went out of their way to make a sushi roll that no longer is on the menu but is my favorite. Highly recommend
